# Code Context (cctx)

> Fast local file discovery, trigram-indexed source search, and smart block-clamped context cache for AI coding agents. Serves both VS Code Native Language Model Tools (`dotnetpower.code-context-native`) and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients from a single shared Rust daemon on Linux, native Windows (`cctx.exe`), WSL, and SSH.

## Key Facts & Measured Impact

- **Retrieval Speedup**: **6.83× faster** on the AKS Store Demo mixed retrieval suite (`3.809 ms → 0.557 ms`, 95% CI `6.65–7.06×`), **11.60× faster** on literal search, and **10.65× faster** on a 506-file Python suite (including **12.88×** on `ignore_case: true` queries via ASCII case-folded trigram indexing).
- **Lookup Token Reduction**: Replacing multi-step `rg` + `view` calls with a single block-clamped `code_context` call cuts tool result payload tokens by **47.5% to 66.2% on Rust** (`29,396 → 9,929` tokens) and **49.5% to 71.1% on Python** (`24,126 → 6,971` tokens), or **84.6% to 91.5%** versus full-file reads.
- **Coding Agent Acceleration (Copilot A/B Trials)**: Reduces tool calls by **61.9%** (`7.00 → 2.67`), LLM round-trip turns by **26.7%** (`5.00 → 3.67`), net session AIU billing cost by **25.4%**, and end-to-end task completion wall time by **24.7%** (`20.31s → 15.30s`) at 100% answer accuracy.
- **Nonblocking Root Cache**: Cold lookups return `CACHE_MISS` immediately and schedule bounded background loading so agents never stall on startup or index warmup.

## Seven Native & MCP Tools

| VS Code Native Tool (`toolReferenceName`) | MCP Tool Name | CLI Subcommand | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#cctxNativeContext` (`code-context-native_codeContext`) | `code_context` | `cctx --backend shared context` | **Primary tool**: search literal/regex and return nearby source snippets in one call with smart function/block boundary clamping (`radius: 0..100`, `limit: 1..64`, `max_matches_per_file`). |
| `#cctxNativeGrep` (`code-context-native_codeGrep`) | `code_grep` | `cctx --backend shared grep` | Fast trigram-indexed literal or regex (`regex: true`, `ignore_case: true`) line search with `paths`, `glob`, and `max_matches_per_file` (prioritizes symbol definitions). |
| `#cctxNativeFiles` (`code-context-native_codeFiles`) | `code_files` | `cctx --backend shared files` | Instant filename and relative-path glob discovery (`glob`, `paths`, `limit: 1..1000`). |
| `#cctxNativeRead` (`code-context-native_codeRead`) | `code_read` | `cctx --backend shared read` | Batched, hash-verified 1-based inclusive line range reads (`ranges`, `split_ranges`, `page`) with transparent live disk recovery. |
| `#cctxNativeStatus` (`code-context-native_codeStatus`) | `code_status` | `cctx --backend shared status` | Observational index state, memory budgets, coverage, and request latency telemetry without loading source. |
| `#cctxNativeSync` (`code-context-native_codeSync`) | `code_sync` | `cctx --backend shared sync` | Explicit waiting full-source synchronization barrier before exhaustive absence claims. |
| `#cctxNativeWorkspaces` (`code-context-native_codeWorkspaces`) | `code_workspaces` | `cctx workspaces` | List registered workspace roots, scopes, globs, and exclusion profiles. |
